summary.text: Amy Lavallee is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 1st Franklin District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as the town clerk of Whately and a member of the Franklin County Regional Vocational Technical School District school board.

paragraphs.text: Amy Lavallee graduated from Frontier Regional High School and earned an associate degree from Greenfield Community College.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a fourth-generation Whately resident who lives with her husband on a small homestead farm and is the mother of three grown children.
She said she worked in educational settings until 2005, in the medical field until 2021, and in municipal government since then, and that she is also a Justice of the Peace and a library associate.
Lavallee said in the survey that she is an independent and non-partisan candidate rather than a politician, and that she wants to serve everyone in the district without a party lens.
She listed affordability and working families, rural communities and local control, and democracy and government accountability among her policy interests.
